def facts():
    full = KV.Operand("full", pitch=32, rows=6)
    pl = KV.plan((full,), "full", 6, 32)
    st = [[s.rows, r0, n] for s, r0, n in KV.stages(pl, 6)]
    k, g, _ = KV.rows_kernel(X.op("mul", X.Load(0), 2.0), (full,), 6, 32, full, DEV.machine.count("VC"))
    text = k.trace(g, machine=TMACHINE).text
    moves = [ln.strip() for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.strip().split(" ")[0] in ("copy", "fill")]
    return {"stages": st, "moves": moves}
